blocks.text: Sullivan Station homes listed and sold, June to October 2026

Sullivan Station, October 2026. Detached houses: 79 listed at month end and 16 sold in October, a sales ratio of 20% (a balanced market). Condos and townhomes: 123 listed at month end and 16 sold in October, a sales ratio of 13% (a balanced market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 45 sold over 5 months against an average of 89.4 listed, about 9.9 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was October with 16 sold. Condos and townhomes: 100 sold over 5 months against an average of 130.8 listed, about 6.5 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 34 sold.

faq.q: Which schools are in the Sullivan area?
faq.a: Sullivan Elementary (6016 152 St), Cambridge Elementary (6115 150 St), Goldstone Park Elementary (6287 146 St), Woodward Hill Elementary (6082 142 St) and the new École Snokomish Elementary (14778 58B Ave, opened January 2026), with Sullivan Heights Secondary (6248 144 St) for Grades 8–12 — but the assigned school for a specific address is set through the SD36 School Locator, and no catchment is asserted here without a locator run.

faq.q: Is there a new school in Sullivan?
faq.a: Yes — École Snokomish Elementary, 14778 58B Ave, a 27-classroom, 655-seat K–7 school, opened in January 2026 for students from the Cambridge, Goldstone Park, Sullivan and Woodward Hill catchments, inheriting Woodward Hill's French Immersion program.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Sullivan Station?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 79 houses listed with 16 sold in the month and 123 condos and townhomes listed with 16 sold in the month in Sullivan Station. Those are month-end counts and move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Sullivan Station a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 20%, a balanced market; condos and townhomes had a sales ratio of 13%, a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
